note: Small City of Little Rock campground in Town & Country Park at the edge of town, beside the ballfield: a gravel loop under trees with electric pedestals. The city does not publish a site count or hookup details; call the city office. --Claude
summary: City camping page: 'Campground is open. $15.00 per night.', dump station for paying campers, phone (712) 479-2852 - all as stored. The page was last edited 2018-05-10, so the $15 rate carries no 2024+ date. Not waterfront confirmed; note trimmed of the rate and dump.
